mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.1% signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in imminent policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 10.0% triggers market anticipation of aggressive fiscal stimulus and monetary policy, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as investors price in economic stabilization.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 10.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as the market overreacts to recessionary risks before policy responses materialize.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both below 95% of 12-month moving average) fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 10.0), a federal funds rate at or below 0.1% signals aggressive policy support for labor markets, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as the market prices in economic recovery.
failure_condition: In periods with UNRATE > 10.0, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment above 137,000 thousand indicates a resilient labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as the market discounts sustained economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 137000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95% of its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing sector deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as the market prices in recessionary risks before policy interventions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 0.95 * INDPRO_12mo_ma.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) below 19,000 billion and housing starts (HOUST) below 1,000 thousand indicate a deepening economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as the market anticipates policy failure.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 < 19000 and HOUST < 1000 fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 480,000) in conjunction with low interest rates signals economic resilience, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 days as the market prices in sustained consumer demand and policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 480000.
